sloka: भर्तारं निहतं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महावलम् ।विललाप भृशं सीता करुणं शोककर्शिता ।। ६.४८.१ ।।।।
transliteration: bhartāraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṁ ca mahāvalam ।vilalāpa bhṛśaṁ sītā karuṇaṁ śokakarśitā ।। 6.48.1 ।।।।

translations.english: On seeing her husband killed and also mighty Lakshmana, Sita became emotional in intense sorrow and cried piteously.
